note: Both sets read the same ten spanwise values from the five subplots of Figure 2-4 and share most of the same errors (chord 100 m at the root, prebend 4 m with the sign dropped, relative thickness 10% at the tip, pitch-axis location 30% at the tip, twist 0.0 deg at the tip). The only substantive difference is the relative-thickness 20% claim: Set A binds it to r/R = 0.0, where the curve is at 100%, while Set B correctly binds it to r/R = 1.0. Set B is therefore slightly more faithful, with one fewer misbound claim. Neither set captures the true root values (chord ≈ 5 m, relative thickness 100%).
remarks: Both extractions appear to pick axis tick labels rather than curve values: 'chord length 100 m at r/R=0.0' is the 100 tick from the relative-thickness axis (actual root chord ≈ 5 m), 'relative thickness 10%' is not even on the 20-100% axis (tip value ≈ 20%), 'pitch axis chord location 30% at r/R=1.0' is the curve minimum near mid-span (tip value ≈ 37%), and 'prebend 4 m at r/R=1.0' drops the minus sign (curve reaches ≈ -4 m). 'twist 0.0 deg at r/R=1.0' is also low (curve ends near -1.5 deg) and 'chord length 0 m at r/R=1.0' is approximate (tip chord ≈ 0.5 m); these were counted as wrong/approximate consistently in both sets. All quotes are only subplot captions and do not contain the quoted values, so no claim is directly supported by its quote in either set.
